test_title: PYST 80: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
By interchanging which two signs and two numbers the equation will be correct?

7 - 6 ÷ 4 × 2 + 5 = 3
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f1f11fbb4e091305a6b414e74c3aec25b8d519670a1f3bd65f5bd4eb1bdcd68.png] Given equation: 7 - 6 ÷ 4 × 2 + 5 = 3 Option 1) - and ÷, 4 and 2 By interchanging which two signs and two numbers (not digits): ⇒ __**7 ÷ 6**__ - 2 × 4 + 5 = 3 ⇒ 1.16 - __**2 × 4**__ + 5 = 3 ⇒ __**1.16 - 8 + 5**__ = 3 ⇒ -1.84 = 3 Option 2) + and ×, 4 and 5
